title: Review of reviews on energy justice
descriptions: This dataset contains the data extracts of a review of reviews on energy justice literature, which was conducted as part of a PhD project that explores the implications of planetary justice for the energy transition. The purpose of the review was to identify the main strengths, weaknesses and proposed revisions of the energy justice framework. The review was conducted in tandem with a conceptual review on planetary justice literature.
